name: 33503-eagledecode-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, draft TP=1; one in-process vLLM engine on one GPU.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 1, bounded at 200 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 10% by completion; `max-num-seqs: 1` matches the one in-flight request.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix bucket: prompt EXACTLY 1024 tokens and output EXACTLY 256, greedy (temperature 0.0), seed 33503. `ignore_eos` is set, so all 256 tokens are generated; the fixed lengths must not be relaxed into a distribution.
purpose: A single-GPU 8B writing assistant with a draft model, turning 1024-token prompts into 256-token replies, one at a time.
launch:
# Engine command line for commit 4bf533623b6957ed27ba3a026df86ee9e2b9685e.
# Interpreter and hardware: configs/env.yaml (not portable, per-machine).

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

# HAZARD -- KEEP AS ONE LINE OF INLINE JSON, AND DO NOT QUOTE IT. This file is read line by line
# with indented lines skipped, so block-style the key parses to nothing: the engine then builds
# with NO DRAFTER and the run finishes at rc=0 looking healthy. A quoted JSON string is rejected
# at engine construction instead.
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle", "model": "yuhuili/EAGLE-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B", "num_speculative_tokens": 8, "draft_tensor_parallel_size": 1, "parallel_drafting": false, "disable_padded_drafter_batch": false}

# 2048 rather than the usual 16384: the draft head's own max_position_embeddings is 2048, and the
# longest request here is 1024 + 256 = 1280 tokens.
max-model-len: 2048

tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-seqs: 1
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
enable-prefix-caching: false
dtype: bfloat16
